title: Override carried; release ledger updated
summary: The Assembly overrode the Council delay on the Near-System Survey and Preservation Act by 456 to 144. The First Term release and its allocation are entered in the ledger.
body: [[DEMO-D-T1-003]]: override of the [[DEMO-B-T1-001-CA1|Council delay]] on [[DEMO-B-T1-001]] — carried, 456 to 144, against a two-thirds requirement of 400. The [[DEMO-B-T1-001-R1|Arbiter had classified]] the Act outside the protected matters, so no veto applied.

No release-size proposal or channel split passed, so the default rules applied: the [[DEMO-REL-T1|First Term release]] is 10.0000 units, divided equally among Endowment, Assembly and Reserve. The Act draws 0.8000 units from the Assembly channel, leaving 2.5334 unallocated.
